title: Epilepsy, Parkinson's disease and multiple sclerosis
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's neurological condition.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for MS.

HPI
Pt is a 61-year-old male presenting for routine follow-up of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis. Pt reports feeling stable over the past few months. No new exacerbations or significant neurological deficits noted since last visit. Continues to tolerate current disease-modifying therapy well with no adverse effects reported.

Medication List
- Interferon beta-1a injection (weekly)
- Vitamin D3 supplement
- Gabapentin 300mg BID

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
Neuro: Alert and oriented x3. Speech clear. Gait steady. Strength 5/5 throughout. Reflexes symmetric and brisk. Coordination intact. Sensation intact to light touch. No new focal deficits.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment
1. Relapsing-remitting MS: Stable on current disease-modifying therapy.

Plan
- Continue current medications as prescribed.
- Maintain current treatment regimen.
- Follow up in 6 months for routine evaluation.

Electronically signed,
K. Nguyen, DO
10/15/2026
explanations: Relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis: G35.A (HCC 198). G35 itself is a header in FY2027.

distractors.why: G35 needs more characters in FY2027.
